title: Westlaw (research)
description: Case law from Thomson Reuters' Westlaw as a research source on legal topics, declared as a service: its request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. Needs Thomson Reuters API access. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: legal, criminal_justice), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine.

questions.help: Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector.
